summary: Quiet residential kerb with a 30m gap between houses; steep, little parking.

best_section.where: Prospect Terrace south kerb between the houses, past the mid-street bend

drivers.seclusion: Nearest mapped homes 15m (at 128m) and 14m (at 153m) on the same side; a roof structure at 1m is non-residential. Rest of the stretch has houses 1-9m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with vegetated verge in places; a few cars parked along the road, room to pull in looks limited.
drivers.traffic: Quiet through street, a bus route nearby; a busy road lies below to the south.
drivers.convention: No signs; few parked cars, so no clear overnight convention.

flags: Steep: about 10% at best section, 7.6% mean, 22% max overall
Dwellings within 10m along most of the rest of the stretch
sun_shade: Garden trees and street trees give patchy shade; houses on the south side shade the kerb from the south.
